checks.check: a guest's own completed run yields a GUEST result payload with no name
the payload carries only allowlisted fields
another device session cannot draw it; a missing run is not_found; an unsimulated run is not_simulated
a signed-in owner's payload carries the safe display name (opt-in on the client) and guest:false
the model is neutral by default; the name appears only when the owner opts in
forged client values cannot reach the card: the builder reads the stored record only
the invitation payload is the allowlisted public view + the trusted link: five, coach and seed never pass even when present on the input
a non-creator, an expired and a revoked Challenge cannot be drawn as an invitation
the origin is the request's own host — a preview export names the preview host, production the production host
alt text and filename carry no name by default, no seed, no id; the code is on the invitation's face and link only
ties and negative margins draw honestly
long names are clipped to 24 characters and stripped of angle brackets
